milestone: A94 scalar BYVAL Generator unpack into bounded BYREF destinations
status: Bounded feature independently validated; complete PHP core remains unfinished

scope.producer: Ordinary named BYVAL Generator without delegation, Closure or method access history; existing retained-CV and temporary input ownership policies apply.
scope.consumer: Actual named function-call source node and compiled name select an ordinary function returning by value. A fixed untyped BYREF parameter is in argument position 1 or 2, within the first two unpacked sends.
scope.behavior: Key/binding Errors precede Warning. Capture HOLD/KEY/Generator INDEX; normally returning callbacks must leave that cache/key/index unchanged. Each send creates a distinct private reference cell, preserving an earlier cell through the second warning and subsequent callee writes.
scope.limits: Dynamic-string or Closure/method sinks, BYREF producers, reference-returning sinks, typed/variadic destinations, owning caches, warning-time advancement and pending warning exceptions remain outside this rule.

implementation.design: Record-or-eps capture makes Warning/refusal branches disjoint. Authority follows ERROR_HANDLER and real API_ERROR send/reference cursors. Source-valid Unsupported cursors keep INPUT/DATA/SENT/HOLD roots and exact reasons; a pending warning Throwable remains under THROW_SEARCH.
